prompt:
A desktop marketing landing page for White Sail Labs, an independent market research lab, rendered edge to edge at 1440 by 900 with crisp readable text, no browser window, device or desk around it.

The visitor is an investor, CEO or strategist deciding whether to request early access. White Sail Labs sells research as a subscription: applied AI engineers and business engineers build an always-on fleet of agents that keeps a living model of every company, and each new fact's surprise travels along the value chain to suppliers and customers.

The page IS a synoptic pressure chart of the economy, filling the whole viewport from edge to edge with no separate hero column. Isobar lines sweep across the entire page, behind everything. Companies sit on the chart as weather-station plots: small circles with wind barbs, a name and a figure, NVIDIA, TSMC, Microsoft, ASML, Apple, Meta, spread across the whole width, no company logos. A front drawn with its triangles and semicircles sweeps out from NVIDIA through its suppliers and customers, labelled "Surprise front · NVIDIA Q3 revenue +$2.9B vs model · Illustrative".

The chart's own title block, a ruled rectangle inset into the chart's lower left corner the way real weather charts carry their legend, holds the headline "Your decisions. Better informed." set very large, the line "A research lab of people and agents, not an AI tool.", and the actions Request early access and Get in touch. The chart's top margin carries a solid sail silhouette with three short speed lines beside the wordmark White Sail Labs, and the navigation Who we are, Capabilities, Careers, Contact. The chart's bottom margin reads "Issued 11 Nov 09:42 · Next update: continuous".

Visual law: a met office chart's crisp white ground with fine black isobar linework, cold-front blue and warm-front red as the only colours, station plots and front symbols as the signature, every label in a clear technical grotesk. One dominant move: the front crossing the whole chart.
note: Second render; the first came back as a split hero and was replaced.
